status: Phase 3 optics model v1 — layered Beer–Lambert with first-scattering correction. Reuses hue-window colorimetry machinery. Mie-scattering parameterisation is approximate. Melanin spectral shapes now use measured Sarna & Swartz 1988 extinction coefficients.

colorimetry.colour_space: CIE 1976 L*a*b*; white is a perfect reflector under the same sampled tables

melanin_absorption.eumelanin_specific_absorbance_provenance: Order-of-magnitude calibration to hue-window absorbance scale (0-8 double-pass at 200 um). Jacques OMLC melanosome interior absorption (1998) gives 500 cm^-1 at 550 nm for pure melanosome; dividing by a plausible internal concentration ~1000 ug/cm^3 yields ~0.5 cm^2/ug. Ten-fold variation is expected per Jacques.
melanin_absorption.eumelanin_spectral_exponent_provenance: UNUSED in this run — retained for provenance only. The spectral shape is now from measured Sarna & Swartz 1988 data (see melanin_spectra). Previously: Jacques OMLC https://omlc.org/spectra/melanin/mua.html (retrieved 2026-10-26).
melanin_absorption.pheomelanin_specific_absorbance_provenan: Order-of-magnitude calibration; the 550 nm magnitude remains assumed. The spectral SHAPE is now measured (see melanin_spectra).
melanin_absorption.pheomelanin_spectral_exponent_provenance: UNUSED in this run — retained for provenance only. The spectral shape is now from measured Sarna & Swartz 1988 data (see melanin_spectra). Previously: assumed; no visible-range pheomelanin spectrum found in open sources.

melanin_spectra.source: Sarna T., Swartz H.M., The physical properties of melanins, in The Pigmentary System, ed. J.J. Nordlund et al., Oxford University Press, 1988
melanin_spectra.host: Natural Phenomena Simulation Group, University of Waterloo / Oregon Medical Laser Center
melanin_spectra.normalization: Each spectrum is divided by its extinction at 550 nm so that the shape equals 1.0 at 550 nm. Eumelanin 550 = 5.79; pheomelanin 550 = 2.994 (units: decadic extinction coefficient, cm^-1 (mg/ml)^-1).
melanin_spectra.provenance_note: The spectral SHAPE is now measured, replacing the previously assumed power-law exponents. The 550 nm specific-absorbance MAGNITUDES remain order-of-magnitude calibrations because no iris-specific mass-absorption calibration was found.

melanosome_optics.melanosome_diameter_provenance: Representative human iris stromal melanosome diameter; electron-microscopy reports 0.3-1.2 um (Prota et al. 1998; Wielgus and Sarna 2005, PMID 16280011).
melanosome_optics.melanosome_refractive_index_provenance: Representative visible-range values for eumelanin; literature reports n = 1.6-1.8, kappa = 0.2-0.5 (Nofsinger et al. and others). Strong dispersion acknowledged. This is a model assumption, not a measured value for iris melanosomes.
melanosome_optics.stromal_medium_refractive_index_provenan: Typical collagen stroma value; Bashkatov et al. 2006 report 1.38 for sclera, lower for hydrated collagen matrix.
melanosome_optics.scattering_anisotropy_g_provenance: Assumed forward-peaked scattering for melanin granules in tissue; typical tissue-optics range for similar particles. Not computed from exact Mie g in v1 to avoid numerical instability at complex refractive indices.

melanosome_density.number_density_provenance: Calibrated to yield backscatter fraction in the hue-window range (0.1-0.4 at 550 nm) for the stated size and Qsca. This corresponds to a melanosome volume fraction of ~0.3-3% in the stroma. No direct human-iris stromal melanosome count was found in open sources.

ipe_background.ipe_eumelanin_mass_provenance: Assumed to reproduce a dark IPE background reflectance comparable to the hue-window dark_pigment_epithelium mode (rho ~ 0.02). Prota 1998 (PMID 9778410) reports IPE fractions but purity and exact compartment mass are uncertain.
ipe_background.ipe_base_reflectance_provenance: Representative scleral/choroidal reflectance behind a non-pigmented IPE (albino path). Dark IPE with 3 ug/cm^2 gives rho = 0.5 * exp(-2 * 3 * 0.5) = 0.028, close to the hue-window 0.02.

path_fraction_provenance: Uniform pigment distribution: half of the stromal absorbance lies above the effective scattering plane, half below.

model_limits.gate_status: Unevaluated until calibration dataset is obtained

tolerances_provenance: Phase 3 v1 planning thresholds; Delta E <= 5 is a conventional just-noticeable-difference bound, 10 percent spectral RMSE is comparable to inter-study ex-vivo variability (specification Section 4.1).

layer_geometry.stromal_thickness_provenance: Assumed 200 um anterior stromal thickness; 100-400 um range covers reported histological variation (Bashkatov et al. 2006 uses a 150 um iris stroma layer).
layer_geometry.ipe_thickness_provenance: Assumed 10 um IPE thickness; 5-20 um range from standard ocular histology.
